answer: Give each verified person one anonymous credential, not one account per name. Every epoch action carries a nullifier derived from that credential and the epoch: act within the limit and you stay anonymous; exceed it and two shares collide, exposing the secret behind the credential so it can be revoked network-wide. A farm gains nothing — a thousand masks share one quota, like a thousand signposts in an atlas pointing to a single garden. The haven is arithmetic: one credential earns one voice's worth of reach, however many lotus blooms it hides behind.
